items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1958-11-26
items.q: And Gustave Joseph, the youngest uncle.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was French, you know. My dad was Val-Saint Joseph, a French name. And Gustave Joseph, the youngest uncle. Did he play? Me, Joseph. They all played with some. All of them did play some. Five brothers of us, all of us played music. And Kaiser, he played many different bands here, and myself.
Were you the oldest of the brothers?
